summary.intent: Land and CI-verify two related PRs (#601 desktop FUSE fix and #600 web-e2e test suite) safely, then resume Phase 72 GSD planning (SDK write-plane correctness fixes) once CI work was clear.
summary.outcome: Committed and pushed #600, rebased it onto main to absorb #601's FUSE fix, dispatched a combined web+desktop e2e CI run which passed fully, squash-merged #600, restored the stashed Phase 72 bookkeeping onto a freshly-synced phase-72 branch, created the Phase 72 GSD directory, decided to skip discuss-phase and go straight to research, and spawned the phase researcher agent.

repo: workflow_dispatch on the ci-e2e workflow always forces both web and desktop jobs — there's no way to dispatch web-only, so branch state must include any prerequisite fixes (e.g. #601's FUSE fix) before dispatching or the desktop job fails spuriously.

Phase 72 ROADMAP (lines 806-841) already fully specifies scope: fail-closed for getWriteBodyParams transient-miss (SC#2) and Option A (refresh+republish parent) for size/mtime mirror staleness (SC#4) — these are locked decisions, not open questions for a discuss-phase.

The hardest Phase 72 item is a `walkChildWriteKey` dedup refactor unifying 7 call-sites with divergent fail-open/fail-closed behavior — flagged as design-first/high-blast-radius, appropriate for research not user discussion.
GSD hook JSON (plan:pre hooks) stores research-fragment strings with raw multiline content that isn't strict JSON, making it unparsable via normal JSON tooling.
workflow: When workflow_dispatch is about to test integration behavior across two branches, check whether the target branch already includes all prerequisite merged fixes; if not, rebase before dispatching rather than dispatching and later re-running.

Before force-pushing after a rebase, re-fetch to confirm no bot commit (e.g. chore(release)) landed on the remote branch in the interim, to avoid clobbering it — used --force-with-lease specifically for this reason.

When resuming a GSD phase, always check for existing phase directory/artifacts (CONTEXT.md, RESEARCH.md, plan files) before assuming a fresh start, since ROADMAP scope may already be detailed even without formal phase artifacts.

When judging whether a phase needs a discuss-step, read all source todos directly rather than trusting surface impression — distinguish 'genuinely open product/UX questions' from 'complex implementation work that just needs research'.

friction: lint-staged / commit hook timed out at 2m, likely due to a hanging 1Password SSH signing prompt (known recurring issue) — required manually verifying the commit had actually landed before proceeding.

Attempting to parse the plan:pre hook JSON to extract a research-fragment failed due to raw unescaped newlines in string values; had to abandon parsing and author the research prompt manually instead of reusing the hook fragment.
open_items: SHARE-WRITE-KEY write-share key threading gap remains open (per prior memory), and Phase 72's walkChildWriteKey dedup refactor may intersect with it.
restore-to-different-parent fix in Phase 72 addresses a flow the web UI doesn't yet ship (restore always goes to original parent) — kept in scope per ROADMAP but flagged as defensive-only for now.
Phase 72 research pass (spawned agent) not yet returned — planning (spawning the actual planner) still pending its output.
